description: This file defines the implementation of the IMediaMetadataRetriever interface for Android, including methods for setting data sources, retrieving frames, images, album art, and metadata, as well as handling IPC transactions.

classes.name: BpMediaMetadataRetriever
classes.description: A proxy class implementing IMediaMetadataRetriever for IPC communication with the media metadata retriever service.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the media metadata retriever service.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source for media retrieval, either via URL, file descriptor, or data source object.

methods.name: getFrameAtTime
methods.description: Retrieves a frame at a specific time with given options.

methods.name: getImageAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an image at a specific index.

methods.name: getImageRectAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a rectangular image at a specific index.

methods.name: getFrameAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a frame at a specific index.

methods.name: extractMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata value for a given key code.
